title: fix(plugin-detail): record:quick_actions draws nothing when its named actions are all withheld (objectui#12995)
body:
Fixes #12995
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`record:quick_actions` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) drew its authoring placeholder, "record:quick_actions — no actions configured", whenever its resolved action list was empty. A member whose named actions were all withheld by `requiredPermissions` saw that false developer sentence on a published page. The empty bar now tells three cases apart:

- **Named actions, all withheld** (or hidden by `visible`, at another location, or with no record to run against): the bar draws **nothing**, as the record header and the row menu do. "Named" is read from the block's own declared list, resolved to action defs **before** the engine's filters. The capability check is not run a second time; `getActionsForLocation` stays its only owner.
- **No action named** (or only ids that resolve to none): the placeholder is drawn only where `usePreviewMode()` from `@object-ui/react` is true, and a runtime view draws nothing. That signal already exists: the Studio page canvas (`PageBlockCanvas`) and the view previews mount `PreviewModeProvider`, and it defaults to `false`. No new context key was added.
- **Refused array** (mixed ids and objects): unchanged. The refusal is still named on the surface and in the console.

`ActionEngine` is unchanged and the spec is unchanged.

The registered `actionNames` input description, which `gen-manifest` publishes, said that with no names "the bar renders its empty placeholder". This change made that sentence false at runtime, so it now says the placeholder shows on a design / preview surface and nothing shows at runtime. This is the one edit in `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`.

## Tests

New pin: `record-quick-actions.withheldEmpty-12995.test.tsx`.
- (a) A block naming two actions, both withheld by `requiredPermissions`, renders nothing: no placeholder, no toolbar, empty text. This holds at runtime and on a preview surface.
- (b) A block naming none renders the placeholder under `PreviewModeProvider` and nothing at runtime.
- (c) CONTROL: a block naming one held action renders that button. A held action next to a withheld one renders only the held one.

Existing pins updated:
- `record-quick-actions.declared-action-ids-7182`: the typo-id empty state is now read on a preview surface.
- `recordQuickActionsInputs.actionNamesFallback`: case 1 is now read on a preview surface. The description pin still matches "empty placeholder".
- `recordBinding.appPage-12294`: with zero rows, the bar now draws no placeholder.

Runs, all at head `beca5c5867`:
- Targeted vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock:
  - Every `record-quick-actions.*` and `recordBinding.*` test, plus `actionNamesFallback`, `declaredActionIds.twoRenderers-7182`, `record-blocks.requiredPermissions-gate`, `recordComponentAria-9556`, `recordAriaLabelRetired-9945` and `detailRendererUndeclaredKeys-8649`: 19 files, 224 tests passed.
  - The cross-package families that name the block (apps/console `record-block-record-reach`, `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `public-contract`, `objectname-binding-required-11605`; app-shell `currentUserCan-*` render tests and `block-config`; plugin-detail `buildDefaultPageSchema`): 8 files, 531 tests passed.
- **Ablation, one-off, no test file kept.** The new `return null` branch was deleted through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob changed from `d1ca207f92dd` to `80ff9331dcef`. With the branch gone, both (a) cases and the runtime (b) case went red: 3 failed, 3 passed. Both (c) controls and the preview (b) case stayed green. The restore was proven by blob hash: the restored file equals the HEAD blob `d1ca207f92dd`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (after building the closure with `--filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build`): exit 0. Tests are covered by `tsconfig.test.json`.
- eslint on the 6 changed files: 0 errors (warnings are of the kinds already present). A narrowed run is a real measurement here because type-aware linting is not enabled, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- The pre-tsc battery (`check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`), plus `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check:new-line-citations`: all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the whole `packages/plugin-detail/` directory. The dispatch declares it to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The page-editor **preview tab** in `PagePreview` (the non-design path that mirrors the runtime) does not mount `PreviewModeProvider`, so it shows what a member sees: nothing for a block that names no action. The design canvas shows the placeholder. This follows the preview's stated intent ("authors see exactly what end-users would see"). It is noted here rather than changed.
- The refused-array placeholder ("… refused at index N (see console)") is still drawn at runtime too. That is developer copy of the same kind, but it is outside this card's ruling. Carrier: none.
- The live smoke `e2e/live/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` already asserts that no "no actions configured" placeholder leaks onto showcase surfaces. This change moves the renderer the same way.
